players.title: Players
players.description: Player names, Transfermarkt player URLs or ids, e.g. Bukayo Saka or https://www.transfermarkt.com/erling-haaland/profil/spieler/418560.

clubs.title: Clubs (whole squad)
clubs.description: Club names, URLs or ids. Returns every player in the current squad.

leagues.title: Leagues (every squad)
leagues.description: premier league, laliga, serie a, bundesliga, ligue 1, eredivisie, liga portugal, mls, saudi pro league, brasileirao, championship, or a Transfermarkt code like GB1. Returns every player of every club.

includeValueHistory.title: Add market value history
includeValueHistory.description: Every past valuation with date, club and age. Adds the player_history event.

includeTransfers.title: Add transfer history
includeTransfers.description: Every transfer with date, from, to, fee and market value at the time. Adds the player_history event.

minMarketValueEur.title: Minimum market value (EUR)
minMarketValueEur.description: Skip players valued below this, e.g. 10000000 for 10 million. Skipped players are not charged.
